findings.title: `include_website_name` is missing `?` and `website_name` is missing from `untrusted_attributes`
findings.body: `UserSerializer` defines `def include_website_name` without the trailing question mark required by ActiveModel::Serializer (`include_website_name?`), so the method is never invoked and `website_name` is always included in the serialized JSON (as `nil` when `website` is blank). In addition, `website` is listed in `untrusted_attributes` (lines 105-111) so that TL0 users' websites are hidden from anonymous viewers, while `website_name` is not. If `website_name` is added to `untrusted_attributes` (which automatically defines `include_website_name?` checking both `scope.restrict_user_fields?(object)` and `website_name.present?`), both the always-included key bug and the TL0 information leak to anonymous users are fixed.

findings.title: `"\.".<< website_host` mutates a string literal in place
findings.body: On line 149, `discourse_host.ends_with?("." << website_host)` uses `<<` on the string literal `"."`, which mutates the literal or raises `FrozenError` when `frozen_string_literal` is enabled. Use string interpolation (`".#{website_host}"`) or `+` instead of `<<`.
